answer:
Autoconf’s `install-sh` originates from the X11R5 script `mit/util/scripts/install.sh`. The Autoconf 2.13 version attributes it to the Massachusetts Institute of Technology:

> “Copyright 1991 by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology”

Later versions state that it was released in X11R6 as `xc/config/util/install.sh`, with a 1994 copyright attributed to the X Consortium. FSF changes to the file are identified as being in the public domain.
